name: spotlights
code: let cps=window.state.cps||0.56;if(window.state.t0===undefined)window.state.t0=millis()/1000;let elapsed=millis()/1000-window.state.t0;let cyc=(elapsed/(1/cps))%1;let beat=Math.max(0,Math.sin(cyc*Math.PI*2));let s=window.state;if(!s.spots){s.spots=[];for(let i=0;i<4;i++)s.spots[i]=({x:width*(0.2+i*0.2),hue:i*80,ph:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,sw:0.6+Math.random()*0.5});}push();blendMode(ADD);noStroke();for(let sp of s.spots){let ang=Math.sin(elapsed*sp.sw+sp.ph)*0.5;let tx=sp.x+Math.tan(ang)*height;let br=(0.4+0.6*beat);push();translate(sp.x,-10);let x1=tx-140-sp.x,x2=tx+140-sp.x;fill(sp.hue,70,100,30*br);triangle(0,0,x1,height+10,x2,height+10);fill(sp.hue,40,100,18*br);ellipse(0,0,60,60);pop();}blendMode(BLEND);pop();
